meta.title: Photo Inspection
meta.description: Before your trading cards ship from Japan, we photograph the front, back, corners, edges, surface and centering so you can spot trouble before it reaches the U.S.

hero.title: Photo inspection before it ships
hero.subtitle: Buying singles from Japan sight-unseen is risky. We open the parcel at our Japan warehouse and send you clear photos of the actual card — so you decide before it crosses the Pacific.

why.title: Why request a photo inspection
why.subtitle: Condition is everything for trading cards. Seller photos are often a stock image, a single angle, or a glare-filled phone shot. A pre-ship inspection lets you catch issues while the card is still in Japan — when a return or cancellation is still cheap and easy.

corners.title: Corners
corners.body: Whitening, fraying or soft corners that downgrade a card are checked up close on every corner.

edges.title: Edges
edges.body: Edge wear, nicks and chipping along all four sides — easy to hide in a seller's thumbnail.

surface.title: Surface
surface.body: Scratches, print lines, dents, clouding and holo scuffing under angled light.

centering.title: Centering
centering.body: Front and back centering, the single biggest factor in a grade, shown so you can judge before you commit.

why.footnote: Especially recommended for graded, sealed, vintage or high-value cards where a small flaw means a big price difference.

order.title: 1. Place your order
order.body: Buy the card as usual. You can add a photo-inspection request at checkout or from My Orders after the item is secured.

warehouse.title: 2. Arrives at our Japan warehouse
warehouse.body: The seller ships to us inside Japan. We receive and log the parcel before anything leaves the country.

photos.title: 3. We photograph it
photos.body: Our team shoots the front and back plus close-ups of the corners, edges, surface and centering under good lighting.

review.title: 4. You review in My Orders
review.body: The photos appear under your order. Take your time to inspect the real card, not a stock image.

decide.title: 5. Confirm or request a return
decide.body: Happy with it? Confirm and we ship it on. Not as described? Request a return or cancellation while it's still in Japan.

example.title: What you'll receive
example.subtitle: A typical inspection set — actual photos of your own card. These are illustrative placeholders, not your card.
example.disclaimer: Illustrative only. No card artwork is shown here — your inspection uses real photos of the exact item you ordered.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.subtitle: Photo inspection is charged per order or parcel, not per card — so consolidating multiple cards keeps it economical.

perOrder.label: Per order / parcel
perOrder.note: One flat inspection fee covers the order, however many cards it contains.

perCard.label: Per additional card
perCard.note: Large lots may carry a small per-card add-on for extra close-ups.

graded.label: Graded / sealed items
graded.note: Slabs and sealed product are documented without breaking the seal.

pricing.note: All figures are estimates to help you plan. Your exact inspection fee is always shown before you pay — see the fees page for the full breakdown.

cta.title: Ready when you are
cta.body: Find a card and request an inspection at checkout, or manage requests for orders you've already placed.
